notes: The tutor now waits for you. It opens on a blank screen with the practice options centred, and says nothing until you pick one or type. There is a button to end a chat and start a fresh one, so a conversation no longer follows you around until you kill the app. The English switch is now just 'Explain in English', and it does much more than before: with it on, the tutor writes TO you in English and gives you the Croatian as short pieces it then explains, instead of sending a full Croatian message and translating one word of it. The Review tab groups packs by level and folds them, opening on the level you are actually on, and it now lists only the packs you have started rather than every pack the level contains.
